Tour Director's Welcome

Tour Director's Welcome

Welcome to the DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Tour

Welcome to Another Exciting Season

Welcome to the DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Tour. We are thrilled to begin another Tour Season here in the DMV area. With tournaments from Ruther Glen, VA to Fayetteville, PA, we will once again bring another fun tour season across the region.

From season long points races, to exciting cash games and the opportunity for a hole-in-one contest, players can look forward to another exciting and competitive season.

Heading into our 17th Tour Season, we look forward to catching up with everyone as the season unfolds. The friendships, competition, and shared passion for golf are what make this Tour special year after year.

Season Long Points

Track your standings and compete for the top spot in your flight.

Cash Games

Optional side games bring additional excitement every tournament day.

Hole-in-One Contests

Take your shot at one of golf’s greatest achievements.

Remember, the Tour is family — and we couldn't do this without each of you.

 

Thank You

Thank you for your loyalty and support of the
DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Tour!

Sincerely,

Thompson Sawyer and Cephas Franklin
DC Metro Tour Directors

DCMetro@AmateurGolfTour.net

571-264-5625 or 214-697-5063
